name: FAA US narrowbody benchmark (partial)
description: PUBLIC BENCHMARK scenario: FAA per-block-hour averages for maintenance, crew and insurance only. Depreciation and rentals are fleet averages mixing owned and leased aircraft and are deliberately not used; ownership, utilization and indirect inputs are absent, so the result is incomplete by design.

rate_per_block_hour.source_reference: FAA, Economic Values for FAA Investment and Regulatory Decisions, Section 4 Aircraft Operating Costs (2024 update), Table 4-7: US Part 121 passenger carriers, Narrowbody 165k lbs or more MTOW (A320 per Table 4-16), YE June 2023, USD per block hour. https://www.faa.gov/regulations_policies/policy_guidance/benefit_cost/econ-value-section-4-op-costs.pdf
rate_per_block_hour.notes: Total maintenance (airframe and engine, Table 4-3 maintenance category). US industry average; applied unadjusted to 2025 (no inflation or currency-region adjustment); not a European or airline-specific cost.

rate_per_block_hour.source_reference: FAA, Economic Values for FAA Investment and Regulatory Decisions, Section 4 Aircraft Operating Costs (2024 update), Table 4-7: US Part 121 passenger carriers, Narrowbody 165k lbs or more MTOW (A320 per Table 4-16), YE June 2023, USD per block hour. https://www.faa.gov/regulations_policies/policy_guidance/benefit_cost/econ-value-section-4-op-costs.pdf
rate_per_block_hour.notes: Crew cost as defined in FAA Table 4-3 (treated as including crew personnel expenses, so allowances are not added). US industry average; applied unadjusted to 2025 (no inflation or currency-region adjustment); not a European or airline-specific cost.

rate_per_block_hour.source_reference: FAA, Economic Values for FAA Investment and Regulatory Decisions, Section 4 Aircraft Operating Costs (2024 update), Table 4-7: US Part 121 passenger carriers, Narrowbody 165k lbs or more MTOW (A320 per Table 4-16), YE June 2023, USD per block hour. https://www.faa.gov/regulations_policies/policy_guidance/benefit_cost/econ-value-section-4-op-costs.pdf
rate_per_block_hour.notes: Insurance per block hour. US industry average; applied unadjusted to 2025 (no inflation or currency-region adjustment); not a European or airline-specific cost.
